## Phase Boundary

Requirements: UPD-18, UPD-19, UPD-20, UPD-21, UPD-22, UPD-23, UPD-32, UPD-24, UPD-27, UPD-15, UPD-28 (full text in `.planning/workstreams/deploy/REQUIREMENTS.md`).

UPD-24's packaged `mar-update-hop` run needs the Phase 45 container-built tarball and complete MAR. Plans therefore build the full-tier `mar-update-hop` row and its self-test against the Phase 40 evidence procedure (fork descriptor + `.mozbuild/mar-hop/` evidence, as today), and assert the ready notification / Restart now / cannot-update message through the in-Gecko WebDriver path that exists now. The Phase 45 packaged re-run is recorded as a Phase 50 criterion, not re-planned here.

## Implementation Decisions

### Already decided (owner, 2026-10-20)
- All owner decisions in REQUIREMENTS.md "Owner Decisions" are binding. Directly relevant here: decision 6 (`identity.fxaccounts.enabled=false` in generated branding prefs, UPD-28); decision 9 (keep `--disable-crashreporter` through the first Windows release — the crash-reports allowlist row is a `deny` row, UPD-15); decision 12 (24-hour canary delay between Release publish and descriptor publish — the update experience must never offer a descriptor that is not published yet).
- UPD-33 (Phase 40): `user-initiated` is a third allowlist disposition; an unattended request to such a host fails like `deny`. UPD-15 adds `github.com` and `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` rows read at layer 3 of a real update; their live observation is Phase 50 criterion 5.
- The update channel name is chosen once and derived everywhere (UPD-11, Phase 40); `ACCEPTED_MAR_CHANNEL_IDS` is the enforcement comparand. No plan renames the channel.
- User-facing text quoted in REQUIREMENTS.md names the product "PowerBrowser" and carries no internal identifier (pref key, port, timeout, sentinel, exception text). UPD-32 extends the `shell-error-copy-no-internals` shape test to the Theia-side copy.

### Owner gates in this phase (stop points for autonomous execution)
- None. ROADMAP Phase 46 has no external gate. Every change is local: shell API, Theia extension, verify rows, allowlist, generated prefs. No live GitHub/Cloudflare/account action, no key, no push.

### Claude's Discretion
All other implementation choices are at Claude's discretion — discuss phase was skipped per user setting. Use ROADMAP phase goal, success criteria, and codebase conventions to guide decisions.

## Specific Ideas

- UPD-18 observers: `update-staged`, `update-downloaded`, `update-available`, `update-error` on the update service, pushing `{kind: 'appUpdate', status, version?}` over the existing `PowerBrowserWebTabState` push path. Every new touchpoint is catalogued in `powerbrowser/INTERNAL-APIS.md`; `check-internals-boundary.sh` stays green.
- UPD-19 request kinds are compared by the quick row `shell-request-kinds` as set equality between what `handleShellMessage` accepts and what the Theia client dispatches; the self-test plants a stray kind. A stray kind is refused with the existing `{ok:false}` shape, never thrown.
- UPD-32 copy row (sibling of `shell-error-copy-no-internals` or an extension of it with its own `--self-test`) derives the UPD-20..UPD-22 strings and UPD-23/TEL-05 titles from the `@powerbrowser/branding` contribution and applies the same shape test (names "PowerBrowser", no internal identifier, next step is an on-screen affordance). Self-test plants a pref key into one string.
- UPD-15 geolocation correction: the `location.services.mozilla.com` deny reason today conflates the region-lookup pref (`browser.region.network.url`, blanked, unattended) with the geolocation provider pref (`geo.provider.network.url`, deliberately untouched, fires only on explicit site request). The corrected row states both halves. Stale texts: `firefox-branding.js:131-132` (region/Push comment scope) and `endpoint-allowlist.json:22` (UPD-12 reason text, changed in Phase 40).
- UPD-27 check shape: with `MOZ_NORMANDY` compiled out, drive `UpdateListener`'s exposure-event call in-Gecko and assert no throw and no network request (layer-1/3 style observation, recorded as full-tier evidence, not an absence-of-log assertion over own instrumentation).
- Research flag: None in SUMMARY. Carried open items only: sidecar egress against verify-endpoints layer 3; Mozilla partner search codes under `org.debios` (recorded, UPD-15).
